posts.title: Becoming a Time Mage to make the engine testable
posts.description: Before I dared to bring my engine 10 years into the future, I built a safety net out of two things, a game clock I could freeze and step by hand and a visual-regression suite that catches a single shifted pixel. This is how it works.

posts.title: Modernising Project GoldScript for 2026
posts.description: After more than a decade as a passion project, I spent 2026 rebuilding GoldScript from the ground up, out of separate repos and aging tooling and into one modern monorepo with the tests to prove nothing broke along the way.

posts.title: AI Overhaul – A Turn Based Interpretation of FFXII’s Gambit System
posts.description: Inspired by FFXII’s gambit system, I’ve overhauled the engine’s AI system for combat encounters
